eps.ov: Transported with his class to another world, Akira quickly discovers that he far surpasses his classmates.

eps.t: The Assassin Takes Care of the Wounded
eps.ov: Akira is fighting his way through the Kantinen Labyrinth when he encounters an injured elf.

eps.t: The Assassin Plays With a Cat

eps.ov: The gang encounters Kilika, Amelia's sister, who holds a massive grudge against her.

eps.t: The Assassin Sleeps In A Bed
eps.ov: Akira and gang head to the land of beastfolk and face new encounters.
Amelia has been abducted, and Akira gets some unexpected aid in his quest to take her back.
Akira faces an unprecedented challenge as Mahiro, another demon, appears to take him on.
His determination renewed, Akira now gets to... watch a beauty pageant?
Akira separates from the hero's party to search for clues about Gram while wandering through a new city.

eps.t: The Assassin Gazes at the River Surface
eps.ov: Crow tells Akira things about Gram to convince him to kill him, but he remembers his family and hesitates.
Akira and the others investigate the Uruk City Adventurer's Guild to obtain information about Gram.
After much deliberation and an unpleasant encounter with Gram at the guild, Akira decides what to do.
